propositions: Five analysis artifacts cited in merged tickets (cranial-goodly-seahog, restoring-shallow-blobfish) do not exist on origin/main, creating unresolvable citations in criteria_routing.json and breaking provenance for the code-v3 calibration and write-parity oracle designs.
The calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py artifact is referenced in three _comment fields of criteria_routing.json but the file is absent from the repository.

The escaped_bug_analysis.py and write_parity_oracle_prototype.py files exist only as untracked working-tree state and have not been committed, preventing inspection of empirical basis for design decisions.
Landing five static documentation/analysis artifacts verbatim to docs/experiments/ (a docs-only directory outside lint/wheel scope) resolves all dangling citations without runtime or CI impact.
Gerrit change 1904 successfully commits all five artifacts (835 insertions, no existing files modified) to make citations resolvable and restore provenance trail.
